feed_title: Raised Dog Day Bed, Rattan Woven Shell with Sun Canopy, Cushion Included, Outdoor Garden Day Bed, One Size | PawLunova Torver
descriptionHtml:
Raised platform. Woven shell. Their chair beside your chair.

Torver is a raised outdoor dog day bed with a woven shell, a cushion and a sun canopy, in one size, for supervised garden lounging in suitable weather.

You shift your chair twice in an afternoon to stay with the sun. They shift with you, and end up lying on paving that has been cooking since breakfast, or flattening something in the border, because nowhere out there is theirs.

A raised platform settles that question. It marks a spot, holds their cushion above the stone, and puts a canopy over the top of both.

What they get

  • A raised platform under the cushion: The resting surface sits up off the paving rather than on it.
  • A cushion supplied with it: You are not buying the frame and then hunting for something to put in it.
  • An open-sided woven shell: The structure stays visually light instead of blocking the view down the garden.
  • A sun canopy over the top: Position it in safe shade. It is for lounging in suitable weather, not all-weather housing.

Best for: Supervised patio or garden lounging in suitable weather.

Why it is worth the money

£109, and three things arrive together: the raised platform, the cushion that goes on it and the canopy above it. Nothing to source separately, and nothing left to make match.

Henley sits beside it at £119 with a slanted canopy and a beige woven finish. This is the one to take if you want them up off the ground.

The honest part: a sun canopy is not a roof. This is not all-weather outdoor housing, so it keeps the same routine as your own garden furniture. Cushion under cover, shell wiped down, everything dry before it is used again.

Size and fit

Please contact us for the exact dimensions before ordering. Check the internal resting area, entrance height and supported load. Your dog should be able to enter, stand, turn and lie comfortably.

Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15 to 20cm. Not sure? Message us their breed and weight and we will tell you honestly whether it fits.

Everyday care

Wipe the shell with a damp cloth and mild soap. Follow the separate care label for any cushion and store soft furnishings under cover. Allow all parts to dry before use.

Outdoor use: Supervise your dog, provide drinking water and safe shade, and move them indoors in extreme weather. A raised bed, canopy or kennel does not prevent overheating.

If your dog is in pain, recovering or finding it hard to move, speak to your vet about the right resting surface. A bed is for comfort. It is not a treatment.

Choose with confidence

This outdoor product has a 30-day change-of-mind window, with return at your cost. It is not covered by the 100-night sleep trial. Your statutory rights are unaffected. Read the full returns and guarantee terms.

The questions we get asked most

Is the canopy fixed in place? Position the whole bed in safe shade and move it as the shade moves. Think of the canopy as shade for a supervised afternoon.

Can I leave the cushion out overnight? Store it under cover. The shell wipes down and every part wants to be dry before they use it again.

Free standard UK delivery on orders over £40. Check delivery timings and any product-specific lead time.

Lift their afternoon up off the paving and put a canopy over it.
